Financial framework

Principles, not prescriptions.

FinSight is shaped by six ideas that have survived decades of advice — not as slogans, but as checks the Copilot actually applies to your numbers.

  • Pay yourself first — at least 10% before anything else.
  • Conscious spending — every category is a Need, Want, Saving, or Investment.
  • Emergency fund first — 3–6 months before ambitious plans.
  • Debt snowball — smallest balance first, for momentum.
  • Compound growth — 10/20/30-year projection from today’s rate.
  • Behaviour over math — nudges about patterns, not just totals.

Get started in minutes ​

  1. 1
    Install FinSight
    docker compose up -d pulls the public image and creates your /data volume. No compile on the server.
  2. 2
    Create your admin account
    First launch shows the setup wizard. Save the one-time recovery key — it is the only way back if a password is lost.
  3. 3
    Add or import accounts
    Create manual accounts or connect SimpleFIN. Import years of CSV history; FinSight deduplicates on import.
  4. 4
    Configure AI (optional)
    Use Ollama to keep inference local, or add an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic provider when you choose. Copilot and auto-categorization are opt-in.
  5. 5
    Start with Copilot
    Ask “What should I fix this month?” — FinSight grounds answers in your actual ledger, not generic advice.

What FinSight is not ​

  • Not a hosted SaaS that holds your data.
  • Not a stock-picking or crypto-trading app.
  • Not a noisy fintech dashboard. If you want piles of coins, confetti, and streaks, this is the wrong product.

FinSight is a quiet instrument — the kind you check in the morning, make one good decision, and close.

Local-first. Encrypted. Yours.
